I added `scripts/export_invoices.py`, ran it to produce `out/invoices.csv`, and committed both as "Add invoices export". `data/2026-01.csv` is still uncommitted, as you asked.

The new script is a copy of `export_customers.py` with the names changed. That includes its filter, which drops rows where `seg` is `C`. `tables/invoices.csv` has a `seg` column too, so the filter applies there. Of the 12 invoices, 9 were written to `out/invoices.csv`.

I took "same as the customers export" to include that filter. If you want all 12 invoices exported, say so and I'll remove it.
